name: Confluence
label: Confluence Cloud REST v2
description: Confluence Cloud REST v2 via OfficialApiNode. https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/confluence/rest/v2/intro/ Basic auth: Atlassian email + API token. page_create / page_update / blog_create take representation + value (nested as body.representation / body.value). attach_file uses v1 multipart POST /wiki/rest/api/content/{id}/child/attachment.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Confluence official API call. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Set operation plus the path/query/body fields that operation lists in api_spec.json. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"page_create"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Official Confluence Cloud REST v2 verb. EXACT: page_create | page_get | page_update | page_delete | blog_create | blog_get | blog_delete | space_get | search | attach_file | listen. listen is ingress. Example: page_create.

schema.label: cloud_id
schema.description: Atlassian cloud id (UUID) for /{cloud_id}/wiki/…. Optional on INPUT when instance configurationParameters.cloud_id is set; otherwise required per HTTP operation. Example: 11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555.

schema.label: spaceId
schema.description: page_create / blog_create required space id (numeric string). Example: 123456.

schema.label: status
schema.description: page_create / page_update / blog_create body `status`. EXACT: current | draft. search query filter. Example: current.

schema.label: title
schema.description: Page or blog title. Required for page_create, page_update, blog_create. search query `title`. Example: Q4 runbook.

schema.label: body
schema.description:
Confluence body envelope escape hatch for page_create/update and blog_create. Purpose fields representation/value merge as body.* via bodyMap. Example: {"representation":"storage","value":"

Hi

"}.

schema.label: parentId
schema.description: page_create parent page id. Example: 789.

schema.label: id
schema.description: Page, blog, space, or attachment parent content id (path {id}).

schema.label: body-format
schema.description: page_get / blog_get / search query `body-format`. EXACT: storage | atlas_doc_format. Example: storage.

schema.label: version
schema.description: Page version envelope escape hatch for page_update. Purpose fields version_number/version_message merge as version.* via bodyMap.

schema.label: space-id
schema.description: search query `space-id`. Example: 123456.

schema.label: limit
schema.description: search query `limit` (1–250). Example: 25.

schema.label: file
schema.description: attach_file multipart part `file`. Platform file ref-id. v1 attachments API.

schema.label: representation
schema.description: Official body.representation. EXACT: storage | atlas_doc_format | wiki. Example: storage. page_create, page_update, blog_create.

schema.label: value
schema.description:
Official body.value (storage HTML, ADF JSON, or wiki markup matching representation). Example:

Hello

.

schema.label: version_number
schema.description: page_update required version.number (must be current version + 1). Example: 2.

schema.label: version_message
schema.description: page_update version.message. Example: Fix steps.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Handler result object. Success: status='ok', http_status, data (parsed JSON). Example: {"status":"ok","http_status":200,"data":{}}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Present on HTTP 2xx. EXACT value: 'ok'. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: HTTP status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status code. Example: 200.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or the raw string when not JSON. Example: {}.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default official API call for this instance when input.operation is blank. EXACT accepted values: page_create, page_get, page_update, page_delete, blog_create, blog_get, blog_delete, space_get, search, attach_file, listen. Default: page_create. Example: page_create.

configurationParameters.label: Api Token
configurationParameters.description: Provider credential for auth.type=basic (configKey api_token). REQUIRED secret — StudioQuack secret binding only; never put this on INPUT. Never logged. Example: 'redacted-token'.

configurationParameters.label: Email
configurationParameters.description: Basic-auth username field (email). Atlassian account email for API-token basic auth. Example: 'ops@example.com'.

configurationParameters.label: Cloud Id
configurationParameters.description: Atlassian cloud id (UUID) interpolated into every HTTP path as /{cloud_id}/wiki/…. Required for HTTP operations; may be omitted on INPUT when set here. Example: '11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555'.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for the official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 25. Example: 25.
